abstract: Struma ovarii is uncommon tumor of ovary which can mimic as advanced carcinoma of ovary. Thyroid tissue is relatively frequent constituent of mature ovarian teratoma. Case of struma ovarii masquerading as cancer of ovary in a female aged 63 yrs showing complex large unilateral multilocular adnexal mass with elevated CA 125 (more than 1721 IU/L) and massive ascites mislead treating surgeons for long time. Clinicians were virtually clueless about preoperative diagnosis. Combination of ascites has been seen in one third cases but association with raised CA 125 is rare(only 8-10 cases so far). This case developed hypothyroidism one week after surgery.
abstract_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は卵巣のまれな腫瘍であり、進行卵巣癌と紛らわしいことがある。63歳女性で、複雑な大型の単房性付属器腫瘤と、CA 125の著明高値（1721 IU/L超）および多量の腹水を認めた症例で、長期間にわたり治療医を誤らせた。術前診断について臨床医はほぼ手がかりがなかった。腹水の合併は3分の1の症例で見られるが、CA 125上昇との併存はまれである（これまでに8～10例のみ）。本症例は術後1週間で甲状腺機能低下症を発症した。
